originalTitle: TeraWulf jumps on $19 billion data center lease deal with Anthropic
simplifiedContent: TeraWulf, a company that used to focus on bitcoin mining, just made a big deal with Anthropic to lease out space in its data centers for 20 years. This deal is worth about $19 billion, which means TeraWulf has a lot of guaranteed revenue coming in. The company is shifting its focus to AI services, and this deal helps support that change. As a result, TeraWulf's stock price went up by over 10%, which is a big increase. The company is also selling one of its investments to free up more money, which will help it move forward with its new plans.

originalTitle: Microsoft shares fall over 1% after company announces to layoff 4,800
simplifiedContent: Microsoft, a big technology company, recently announced that it will be letting go of about 4,800 employees worldwide. This means that many people who work for Microsoft will lose their jobs. The part of the company that makes Xbox games will be affected the most, with around 3,200 jobs being cut. As a result, the value of Microsoft's shares (or "stock") has gone down by over 1%. This change in the company's stock price might be important for people who own Microsoft shares or are thinking of investing in the company.

originalTitle: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Tuesday
simplifiedContent: The Indian stock market had a good day, with the Sensex going up by 521 points and the Nifty closing above 24,430. This was the fourth day in a row that the market has gone up. The market is doing well because of good weather forecast, foreign investors buying stocks again, and stable oil prices. This is also helping investors feel more positive about the companies' upcoming earnings reports. Overall, these factors are helping the Indian stock market stay strong, even when other global markets are not doing as well.

originalTitle: Gold, silver prices today: Comex gold tops $4,200, silver nears $64 as recovery rally extends; Fed minutes in focus
simplifiedContent: The prices of gold and silver went up a bit on July 6th. This happened because people are less worried that the US Federal Reserve will raise interest rates, and the value of the US dollar decreased. As a result, gold futures reached $4,215 and silver reached $63.73, which is an improvement from their previous lower prices. This matters because it shows that investors are feeling more positive about these precious metals. The prices may continue to be affected by upcoming news from the Federal Reserve, which will release its meeting minutes soon.

originalTitle: Trent Q1 business update: Revenue grows 19%, store network expands
simplifiedContent: Trent, a company owned by the Tata Group, had a good quarter with sales increasing by 19% compared to the same time last year, reaching ₹5,666 crore. The company also opened more stores, now having a total of 1,312 outlets. This news is important because it shows that Trent is growing and expanding its business. The company's stock price, which had previously gone down, recently increased by 17.2%, although it's still not at its highest point. This update suggests that Trent is doing well, which could be a positive sign for investors.

originalTitle: Rentomojo gets SEBI nod for raising funds through IPO launch. Details here
simplifiedContent: Rentomojo, a company that rents out furniture, has gotten approval from a government regulator called SEBI to launch an initial public offering (IPO). This means the company can now raise money from the public by selling shares. The money raised, up to ₹150 crore, will be used to expand the business and pay off debts. Existing shareholders will be selling some of their shares in the company as part of the IPO. This is significant because Rentomojo is a major player in India's online rental market, and the IPO could be an opportunity for new investors to get involved.
